A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research, renamed from IntenTest to TAI3. Their complete text, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–J support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original agent-testing experiments, including error-exposing rates, query efficiency, partition coverage, ablations, transfer analyses, and product-agent case studies.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–5 and the experimental figures and case studies in the appendices.

M1.justification: TAI3 retains IntenTest's semantic partitioning, seed generation, intent-preserving mutation, likelihood-based prioritization, and datatype-aware strategy memory. The renaming and revised equation notation do not establish a changed procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same 80 toolkit APIs and 233 parameters across five domains. Agent-SafetyBench and ToolEmu coverage analyses and the Self-Operating Computer and Proxy AI case studies are also retained.

E2.justification: SelfRef remains the main baseline. Random and Select Last 5 remain the prioritization comparators, and Appendix F retains SelfRef+Predict and SelfRef+Retrieve. No comparator is added or removed from the corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: The model sets, five-query budget, 15-candidate prioritization experiment, EESR/AQFF metrics, and benchmark coverage procedure remain unchanged. Section 5.1's explicit description of open-source testing models restates participation already shown in v1's Figure 7.

E4.justification: The prioritization analysis and Appendices C–G retain the same naturalness assessment, cross-domain and cross-datatype transfer tests, product-agent cases, component ablations, and retrieval-count sensitivity analysis.

E5.justification: Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The statistical reporting practices in the retained experiments are unchanged.

E6.justification: The matched tables, plots, and case studies retain their numerical results and findings. For example, Table 1's Finance/Llama VALID comparison remains 80.5% versus SelfRef's 65.0%, and Table 5's full-method results remain 63.5%, 62.4%, and 64.3%.

T1.justification: The trajectory, intent-preservation, and partition definitions are retained. Equation 1 changes token notation from I to T and explains sequence concatenation, while retaining the stated conditional intent-likelihood calculation. No substantive derivation, assumption, or proof is added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning systematic intent-integrity testing, effectiveness, efficiency, and generalization. The new title does not change the research scope.

C2.justification: Results interpretations, strategy-transfer explanations, and the limitation requiring access to API-call trajectories remain unchanged. The scope paragraph is rephrased but retains the same focus on benign tasks and exclusion of adversarial scenarios; Appendix J's impact discussion is preserved.

D1.justification: The documented prompts, toolkit inventory, preprocessing, model identities, and hyperparameters remain unchanged. Model-role clarification repeats existing information, and the new acknowledgements provide resource-provider credits without additional technical specifications or code/data access instructions.

R1.justification: v2 adds Section 2.3 on autonomous-system robustness, distinguishing intent interpretation from perception, planning, and software robustness. It also adds network-protocol-related citations and sharpens the ToolFuzz comparison. Thirteen references are added while the original works and central positioning are retained.

P1.justification: The title and framework name change throughout. v2 adds a short related-work subsection and acknowledgements, standardizes sampling terminology, and lightly clarifies scope, model roles, and equation notation. Most prose and the overall section sequence remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 compacts the author block, updates Figure 1's branding, resizes some diagrams, and places Table 2 above Figures 5–6 on page 9. All five tables and sixteen figures are retained with the same substantive content.

improvement.justification: The added autonomous-system discussion in Section 2.3 provides useful research context, while clearer testing-versus-target model descriptions and terminology modestly improve readability. The method, empirical support, and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall quality gain is limited.
